geometry: User-authored rmuc-layered-arena.v1 data, constrained to the exact native fixed-point profile
sample: Deliberately synthetic ramp, tunnel and stacked deck; no official geometry inferred
clock: 60 fixed ticks per second; configured tick limit is not match judgement
rule_behavior: No official scoring, combat, capture, winning or referee decisions
identity: SHA-256 of named source files; separate canonical SHA-256 for full authored map and configuration
policy_sdk: Version 1; bounded owning immutable pre-step snapshots and shared native action validation
policy_execution: Trusted local C++ linked into the native process, not a sandbox; stateless snapshot-only controller contract
policy_observation: Full authored geometry, one current robot pose, fixed tick, movement configuration, previous-tick contacts/events and active triggers; no provenance text or paths, source hashes, replay/history, or plugin data
replay: rmuc-layered-replay.v2 verifies resolved actions without invoking controller callbacks; source labels are unauthenticated declarations, not proof of policy determinism
identity_limits: Only explicitly named files are hashed; not compiler flags, compiler/standard-library versions, arbitrary transitive includes, external code or a cryptographic digest of the executable
limitations: No jump, gravity, dynamics or automatic adjacency
20-second command watchdog is not a per-tick CPU quota or an overall restore-request deadline
Discarding a candidate cannot roll back external I/O, global process effects, or descendant processes
Trusted code can access its process and machine beyond the supplied observation
